_note: 2024 PHB backgrounds (16). New model: each raises 3 listed ability scores (+2/+1 or +1/+1/+1), grants an Origin feat, 2 skill proficiencies, 1 tool proficiency, and an equipment package (or 50 GP). Descriptions are original; source 'phb'. Ability/feat/skill/tool mappings verified against 2024 PHB.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
equipment: Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10 sheets), Robe, 8 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, learning its rites and doctrines. Whether you still keep the faith or have wandered from it, its teachings shaped how you see the world.

backgrounds.name: Artisan
equipment: Artisan's Tools (one of your choice), 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 32 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You apprenticed to a skilled crafter, learning a trade and the business of selling what you make. Your hands know the feel of good work.

backgrounds.name: Charlatan
equipment: Forgery Kit, Costume, Fine Clothes, 15 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You made your way by wit and misdirection — a forged letter here, a confident lie there. People believe what they want to believe, and you help them.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
equipment: 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You lived outside the law, working jobs that required quiet feet and quick hands. You know how to spot an opportunity and how to disappear afterward.

backgrounds.name: Entertainer
equipment: Musical Instrument (one of your choice), 2 Costumes, Mirror, Perfume, Traveler's Clothes, 11 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You performed before crowds — music, drama, acrobatics — and learned to read a room and hold its attention. The applause never quite leaves your blood.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
equipment: Sickle, Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You grew up working the land, rising with the sun and enduring hard seasons. That steady labor built a body and a patience that don't quit.

backgrounds.name: Guard
equipment: Spear, Light Crossbow, 20 Bolts, Gaming Set (one of your choice), Hooded Lantern, Manacles, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 12 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You stood watch — on city walls, at a gate, or over a caravan. Long hours taught you to stay alert and to notice what doesn't belong.

backgrounds.name: Guide
equipment: Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Cartographer's Tools, Quiver, Bedroll, Traveler's Clothes, Tent, 3 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You lived close to the wilds, learning their paths and dangers. You can find water, read a trail, and lead others safely through country that would swallow them alone.

backgrounds.name: Hermit
equipment: Quarterstaff, Herbalism Kit, Bedroll, Book (philosophy), Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You spent a long stretch in seclusion — a hermitage, a monastery, or the deep wilderness — seeking something. In that solitude you learned the healing arts and hard truths.

backgrounds.name: Merchant
equipment: Navigator's Tools, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 22 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You worked the trade routes, buying low and selling high, learning to judge people and goods alike. A good deal is a kind of art, and luck rarely hurts.

backgrounds.name: Noble
equipment: Fine Clothes, Gaming Set (one of your choice), Perfume, Signet Ring, 29 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You were raised among privilege and expectation, schooled in history, etiquette, and the games of power. Doors open for your name — and close for it too.

backgrounds.name: Sage
equipment: Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 8 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You pursued knowledge in libraries and studies, chasing questions others left alone. Somewhere in those pages you brushed against real arcane power.

backgrounds.name: Sailor
equipment: Dagger, Navigator's Tools, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 20 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You crewed a ship, learning the rigging, the weather, and the rough company of ports. You keep your footing on a rolling deck and hold your own in a brawl.

backgrounds.name: Scribe
equipment: Calligrapher's Supplies, Fine Clothes, Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Parchment (12 sheets), 23 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You copied and drafted documents for a living, developing a sharp eye for detail and error. Words are your craft, and little on a page escapes you.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
equipment: Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (one of your choice), Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You served in a fighting force, drilled in weapons and discipline. Battle taught you to hit hard and to bear what you've seen.

backgrounds.name: Wayfarer
equipment: 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Gaming Set (one of your choice), Bedroll, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: You survived on the streets or the road, relying on your wits and a stubborn streak of luck. You've learned to take care of yourself and the people you count as your own.
